[ עֲרָבָה ] noun [masculine] poplar ( populus Euphratica = Arabic We in De Gn (4), 568 Kersten ZPV ii. 209 De Is (4) 44, 4 Löw p. 300 Anm .; Late Hebrew עֲרָבָה √ obscure); — plural absolute עַליִֿבְלֵימָֿ֑יִם עֲרָבִים Isa 44:4 , compare Psa 137:2 ; construct עַרְבֵינָֿ֑חַל Lev 23:40 (H), Job 40:22 ; נַחַלהָֿעֲרָבִים Isa 15:7 (a wady in Moab; identification dubious, see conjectures in Buhl Geogr. 124 ).
